name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport started in his father's auto repair shop in Montreal. He developed a keen eye for detail, meticulously inspecting and troubleshooting engine problems. He honed his skills through vocational training and quickly found his niche in quality control. Jean-Pierre is known for his rigorous approach and unwavering commitment to ensuring that every component meets the highest standards. He's a firm believer that meticulous preparation is the key to success on the track.

His demanding nature stems from a deep-seated belief that only perfection can yield victory. He meticulously reviews data logs, scrutinizes parts, and isn't afraid to challenge engineers when something doesn't meet his exacting standards. Jean-Pierre is driven by a desire to contribute to the team's success and takes immense pride in knowing that his work helps them push the boundaries of performance. His ambition is to one day lead a quality control team for a top-tier motorsport organization.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a miniature inspection mirror.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when reviewing data.
Insists on using a specific brand of cleaning wipes for all parts.
